signal: Merlyn Mind partnered with Google Cloud to power its education AI infrastructure and is scaling Merlyn Origin across classrooms

email.body1:
Brett, saw Merlyn leaning into the Google Cloud partnership to scale Origin across more classrooms.

Ecosystem moves like that usually open more co-sell and partner targets than a BD team can personally work before momentum fades, and that is where partner-sourced pipeline stalls. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up across the partner ecosystem autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play mapping Merlyn's partner ecosystem off hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Brett, quick follow-up for Merlyn.

Most partnerships teams know their co-sell motion works but cannot personally touch every district or partner account that fits, so warm intros sit cold and the channel underdelivers. The fix is rarely more BD headcount, it is faster signal-to-touch on the accounts already in motion.

I put together a co-sell pilot playbook scoped to Merlyn's education channel, three plays you could run without adding reps. Want to grab 15 minutes and I will walk you through it?
email.body3:
Brett, last bit of proof for Merlyn.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a pipeline gap analysis on what partner-sourced coverage could look like for Merlyn. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Brett, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling partner-sourced pipeline without adding BD headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. The stretch right after a big infrastructure partnership is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your partner ecosystem? I will tailor it to Merlyn either way.
